_description: Alien abilities (roadmap Phase 4; applied by alien.py and world.py). The key is the client's npcId (npc.json npc_id, gates.json npc_id): the same alien comes with the same ability on the map and in the gate. Source belgeler/wiki/aliens.md (wiki); where the wiki gives no numbers, see the '_adaptation' note. Fields: summon_on_hit {type, count, max_count, cooldown_sec, first_cooldown_sec (on the first hit after calm_sec (15) without being hit, the summon happens this long afterwards), calm_sec, interval_sec (the swarm comes out in succession at this interval), guard {radius: [min, max], leash (if absent, max + firing range)} (summoned ones roam around the summoner; also while attacking, keeping the player within their range; if the player is farther from the summoner than the leash, they stop chasing)}, regeneration {hp_sec, shield_per_sec, cooldown_sec}, spawn_on_death [{type, count}], invulnerable_while_summons_live, repair_while_summons_alive {hp_sec}, anger {attacker, duration_sec, damage_multiplier, extra_summon, repair_hp_per_sec}, summon_at_hp_threshold [{ratio, type, count}], cloak_breaker {range}, slowing_shots {speed | ratio, sec, range}, multi_target {hp_ratio}, rocket {damage, cooldown_sec, launcher, count, type (old rocket id; 1 if absent), rockets [special rocket ids: each shot one at random, its items.json effect on the player]}, singularity {damage_per_sec, maximum, duration_sec, range, cooldown_sec, visual (vortex; present if absent), emp_clears (the player's EMP ends it)}, explode_on_contact {damage, radius, inverse_absorb (the shield takes the hull's share), cloak_breaks_lock}, disappear {damage, fake, distance, explosion, explosion_radius, fake_lifetime_sec, hp_sec, shield_per_sec}, sticky_bomb {damage, interval_sec, delay_sec, group}, speed_skill {speed, shield_ratio}, capsules {count, interval_sec, collect_ms, harvest_distance, hp, shield, damage}, summons_scatter_on_death {lifetime_sec}, kamikaze_threshold {ratio, wait_sec, approach_sec, radius, damage_hp_ratio}, reverse_controls {shield_ratio | hp_ratio, sec}, flee_repair {ratios} (flees and repairs like low_hp once below each HP ratio). improvement {hp_sec | hp_ratio, cooldown_sec, range, target [name fragments; if absent, every alien]} (repairs the hull of nearby aliens, not itself), follow {target (name fragment), radius [min, max]} (roams around that alien in the guard pattern), periodic_summon {cooldown_sec, summons [{type, count, max_count}]} (summons even if not hit while fighting), drop_mine {mine, hp_ratio, cooldown_sec, max_count, target, radius [min, max]} (while its HP is below hp_ratio and it is fighting, it drops a mine: at the alien's position, or around the player if target is true; it does not drop a new one while max_count mines are alive), periodic_emp {cooldown_sec, range}, death_beam {damage, interval_sec, distance} (while fighting, when the player is farther than distance from the Overlord, damage once every interval_sec), emp_on_shield_down (bool: EMP every time the shield runs out), critical_emp {hp_ratio} (once), reverse_shot {sec, cooldown_sec} (a laser that hits reverses the controls), player_speed {extra, hp_ratio} (speed equal to the player's; if hp_ratio is present, only at that HP), explode_on_contact.at_edge (the remaining share of the damage at the edge of the explosion radius; full on contact), sticky_bomb.damage can be [min, max]. Top-level "low_hp": low-HP escape and parking of map strays (alien.low_health; ratio, return_ratio, edge_margin, regeneration, range_boost).

guard._return: Player report 2026-10-28: in the real game the Protegits do not return when the attack is dropped, they fight the player until the Cubikon dies (no drop-off time); only the leash (the player being very far from the Cubikon) makes them stop chasing

13._source: aliens.md: releases Protegits when hit (30x Protegit in the table), up to 125,000 HP per second when not attacked; fandom: Protegits come out immediately in swarms of 20-30, when the Cubikon dies they roam without chasing anyone and then disappear
13._adaptation: 25 Protegits per summon (max 30), 4 s cooldown; the swarm comes out in groups of 2-3 per second within 500-1100 units of the player (from a bit farther, just outside the screen); at the start of the summon ShipSpawnChildSwarmCommand opens the Cubikon (client SpawnChildrenEffect, animator npc_cubikon open; user report and video 2026-10-27); they come out 3 s after the first hit (user report 2026-10-25: they used to come out immediately on the first shot); regeneration after 10 s without being hit; when the Cubikon dies the Protegits roam for 10-20 s and disappear (user report 2026-10-25: at most 20 s; those of other Cubikons are unaffected). While attacking, Protegits hit and run: they come within 150-320 units of the player, for 1-2.5 s (one or two shots), move away to 450-850 units (keep firing if in range), approach again after 0.8-2.5 s; each one on its own side, scattered (user report 2026-10-27; previously they all clustered right on top of the player); when not attacking they roam within 250-750 units of the Cubikon; if the player is farther than 1,600 units from the Cubikon they stop chasing and roam around the Cubikon (user report 2026-10-25: they used to chase the player very far away); official server recording 2026-10-27: 20 Protegits 5.4 s after the first hit (0|n|s|<Cubikon>|20|<ids>), spawning within 100-2,650 units (median ~1,500) of the Cubikon and the player; count, first cooldown and spawn radius follow this (the grouping stays against getting stuck)

low_hp._description: Low HP of map strays (alien.low_health, world.think): an alien whose HP drops below ratio flees to the edge/corner point opposite the player (fires if in range), stops on arrival and regenerates (after cooldown_sec without being hit, hp_ratio_per_sec of max HP per second, shield_ratio_per_sec of the shield; does not fire), and returns to normal behavior once regenerated to return_ratio. Those that do not flee: gate/mode/event aliens, summoned ones, immobile ones, motherships and special bosses (npc.json combat.respawn_special), pirate maps (5-X), Barracuda (kamikaze_threshold) and Hooligan (player_speed). range_boost: for types whose name fragment matches, the firing range while fleeing rises to a multiplier times its normal value.
low_hp._source: fandom (Low health, Parking, Critical Health): generally below 20% the alien flees to fixed points at the edge of the map and keeps firing while fleeing; at critical HP it goes to the corner of the map opposite the player, stops there and regenerates its shield/HP, can be hit and does not fire back; Kristallon's and Kristallin's range rarely increases at low HP; motherships (Cubikon, Ice Meteoroid) and pirates do not flee; Barracuda explodes
low_hp._adaptation: escape points: the four corners of the map and the four edge midpoints (700 units inside), the one farthest from the player; regeneration 1% HP and 5% shield per second (no number in the source) and return once fully restored; range increase x1.2 (no number in the source); event aliens do not flee since they run on their own flow (boss duration, quota); Hooligan does not flee because at critical HP its speed is matched to the player's (threat)
